verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented power envelopes (TDP or wattage), no thermal or throttling data, and no independent sustained-load or performance-per-watt testing. Apple's claims of faster rendering and the 24-hour video-streaming battery figure speak to peak speed and light-load battery life, not long renders or exports. The community Geekbench numbers are short burst benchmarks, so they don't show sustained performance either.
